VideoLessonsPage.sectionDividerText: Whether you need help catching up, revising for exams, or mastering difficult topics, Math Mentor provides a complete learning experience aligned with the curriculum.

VideoLessonsPage.feature2Desc: Complex concepts are broken down into easy-to-follow steps.

VideoLessonsPage.feature4Desc: Real problems solved step-by-step with detailed explanations.
